title: Disconnecting in a Connected World: The Dynamics of Social Media Non-Use
discussion_signal: The author describes non-use attempts among young adults as nonlinear and reversible, shaped by platform resources, psychological discomfort, user experience, and social pressure. The result is less a clean exit than an ongoing renegotiation with platformized life.
linked_research_question: When people try to leave or limit social media, which platform and social dependencies make non-use reversible rather than a stable exit?
limits: Study concerns in-depth interviews with young adults in South Korea
The post summarizes qualitative evidence rather than population prevalence
